title: Pure Meklord
summary: Meklord cards only, with generic Rank 4s, Links and staples. Meklord is a Machine deck that destroys its own monsters on purpose: each Meklord Emperor summons itself from the hand when a face-up monster you control is destroyed by a card effect, then steals Synchro Monsters as equips. The 2020 cards lead. Meklord Nucleus Infinity Core searches a Meklord Spell/Trap, and when destroyed by an effect summons a Meklord Emperor from the hand or Deck. Meklord Army Deployer Obbligato destroys itself for two Meklord Army monsters from the Deck. Meklord Assembly searches and destroys your own monster to set the Emperors off. Meklord Emperor Wisel - Synchro Absorption joins on their turn and negates a destruction effect. Meklord Astro Dragon Triskelion banishes three Meklords to come out and equips a monster from their Extra Deck. Obbligato and Meklord Astro the Eradicator lock you to Machines.
